mechanism_summary: Pressure build-up, valve opening, ambient/nozzle state, and chronology establish a developing underexpanded jet before quasi-steady behavior.
key_parameters: p_inj(t); NPR(t); ambient pressure/density/temperature; nozzle geometry; gas properties
key_conditions: pressure definition; valve state; real-gas state; transient event alignment
main_limitation: Direct HPDI-resolved formation evidence is less complete than vessel/free-jet evidence.

mechanism_summary: Compatible contextual NPR and boundary state organize Mach-disk formation/location and shock-cell topology, with transient motion distinct from settled structure.
key_parameters: definition-complete NPR; Mach-disk x/D; shock-cell spacing; nozzle geometry; gas species
key_conditions: formation/overshoot/stabilized state; near/far field; pressure role/type
main_limitation: Quantitative diameter/cell correlations are less constrained than Mach-disk position.
notes: Strongly closed within compatible gas-jet conditions.

mechanism_summary: Shock topology resolves local gas-state changes in gas-jet and analogue studies, but conversion to the loading history experienced by HPDI pilot droplets is not directly measured.
key_parameters: p(x,t); rho(x,t); u(x,t); pressure/velocity jump; local Mach; loading duration
key_conditions: wave origin; spatial location; transient timing; reference frame; hot dense ambient
main_limitation: Direct support ends at gas-state or canonical loading components; the B/C-to-A edge is inference.
notes: Closure requires co-located high-speed pressure/velocity/shock and pilot-droplet diagnostics.

mechanism_summary: Definition-complete loading magnitude, duration, Mach/We context, size, and material state govern deformation; internal waves and collective interactions provide additional pathways.
key_parameters: M_s; M_rel; We; Re; Oh; d0; density ratio; loading duration; S/D
key_conditions: reference definitions; isolated/ordered/cloud geometry; liquid and phase state
main_limitation: Dense polydisperse reacting HPDI spray validation is absent.

mechanism_summary: Sheets, rims, waves, RT/KH/shear/capillary competition, and recurrent ligament processes produce condition-dependent breakup modes.
key_parameters: definition-complete We; Mach context; loading duration; Oh; d0; breakup time/mode
key_conditions: forcing history; taxonomy; liquid properties; arrangement
main_limitation: Universal critical-We boundaries are not supported and C004 is missing.

mechanism_summary: Breakup yields time-evolving fragment distributions; fragment state and collective attenuation then govern transport and cloud response.
key_parameters: fragment PDF/D10/D32; velocity; spacing; volume fraction; cloud length
key_conditions: sampling time; detection threshold; wave origin; population density
main_limitation: Fragment-size, velocity, and spacing statistics are sparse.
notes: Direct mechanism but incomplete product-state quantification.

mechanism_summary: Breakup and evaporation can overlap, while vapor-layer shear reduction and thermally reduced surface tension can drive opposite deformation effects.
key_parameters: d0; fragment size; evaporation time/length; gas temperature; volatility; Stefan/density ratios
key_conditions: liquid; thermal state; observation interval; post-wave history
main_limitation: The suppression-to-promotion transition boundary is not condition-matched.
notes: Direction is conditional rather than contradictory.

mechanism_summary: Transport and evaporation generally redistribute fuel, but direct HPDI evidence isolates chronology/geometry effects rather than the contribution from shock-generated fragments.
key_parameters: fragment transport; evaporation time/length; injection timing; overlap; geometry
key_conditions: hot dense ambient; walls; swirl/turbulence; volatility; mixture diagnostic definition
main_limitation: General atomization/evaporation physics is not direct HPDI mixture-field evidence.

mechanism_summary: Injection chronology, overlap, pilot-product entrainment, and mixture stratification directly govern ignition and heat-release mode, but the upstream shock-mediated causal path is open.
key_parameters: DeltaSOI; ignition delay; injection duration; overlap; ambient temperature/oxygen; energy share
key_conditions: event definitions; fuel pair; geometry; load and operating point
main_limitation: Shock-caused mixture change to ignition/combustion is not directly measured.
notes: Direct A-library pathway and separate inference are not conflated.

mechanism_summary: Droplet loading, breakup, and evaporation scales affect wave response, while reacting post-wave history changes droplet dynamics relative to inert shocks.
key_parameters: detonation Mach; post-wave state; d0; evaporation length; L_E/L_D; breakup time
key_conditions: fuel/chemistry; geometry; wave multiplicity; pre-vaporized fraction; scale definition
main_limitation: Mostly numerical/application-scale and not directly transferable to HPDI.

mechanism_summary: Canonical loading-to-breakup mechanisms and collective corrections form a mechanistic basis, but no experiment closes shock structure to pilot loading to breakup to ignition in HPDI.
key_parameters: definition-complete NPR/Mach/We; loading duration; d0 distribution; S/D/cloud descriptors; evaporation/ignition scales
key_conditions: geometry; polydispersity; dense-spray collective effects; thermal/reaction state; synchronized chronology
main_limitation: Application transfer remains indirect-only by Phase 10 evidence.
notes: No Phase 11 upgrade to direct support.
